lee: Morning — quick async: onboarding orca-lite-7B-q to infra. Ran evals on promptset 'customer-support-es' and 'rating-lite'. Seeing quality regressions on multi-step Spanish prompts (hallucination + truncation).
sam: Can you paste failing examples?
lee: Sure, pasted below.
lee: ```
input: "Cliente compró, ahora tiene problema con la instalación, qué debe hacer?"
output: "We recommend contacting support at..."
expected: Respuesta en español con pasos claros. Actual: mixed English and drops last step.
```
nora: Repros look like tokenizer cutoff. Which quant/config?
lee: Using 4bit q4_k_m with kv-cache warmup disabled. Perf good but gets truncated around 512 tokens.
ash: Quick check — try enabling kv warmup + adjust max_new_tokens to 400. Also run `./eval/run_eval --model orca-lite-7B-q --prompts customer-support-es --metrics perplexity,exact_match`.
eval-bot: Eval job 6278901235 started on dedicated-3 (ETA ~8m). Results -> https://redwood.infra/evals/6278901235
lee: Thanks. Also I filed PR #4523 with config change and description. CC @maria for prompt review.
maria: Reviewing now. Noted a few prompt anchors that encourage English. Suggest tightening system instruction: "Responder en español." Also add few-shot Spanish examples.
sam: If PR passes, let's canary on staging with 5% traffic. I'll add rollout flag.
nora: Blocker: don't have Spanish eval data for multi-turn billing flows. I can create synthetic 80 samples by EOD.
ash: I'll run smoke on ded-dev once PR merges.
lee: Updated thread with eval link and PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4523
maria: :thumbsup: I'll post prompt edits inline.
sam: Great. Anything else?
lee: One more — noticed token cost increased ~5% for this model variant. I'll open an infra ticket to check kernel selection.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: staging/orca-lite-7B-q-config-4523 -> pending approval.
lee: OK, thanks all. I'll follow up tomorrow morning with smoke results.
